summary: Allocates a 92-byte JPEG APP-marker state dispatch table through an allocator vfunc reached at this+0x4, stores it at this+0x190, then fills its slots: slot 0 StateReset, slot 1 CommandDispatchStateMachine, slot 2 StateCounterWithDispatch, slot 3 StreamingDataReader, slots 4..18 default StreamingDataReader, slot 4 overridden to JPEGMarkerParsing and slot 18 to AdobePSDHeaderParser. Ends by calling StateReset on the receiver. Called from sub_50F632.

local_names.a1: JPEG decoder/receiver object holding the allocator vtable pointer at +4
local_names.i: byte slot index walking the table from 16 to below 80 in steps of 4

operations.description: Calls the allocator vfunc read from *(this+4) with receiver a1 and arguments 0, 92 to obtain a new 92-byte state table
Stores the allocated table pointer at this+0x190
Fills the first four table slots: table+0 StateReset, table+4 CommandDispatchStateMachine, table+8 StateCounterWithDispatch, table+12 StreamingDataReader
Walks table byte offsets 16 through below 80 in steps of 4, writing StreamingDataReader as the default handler into every slot
Overrides table+16 with JPEGMarkerParsing (APP0/JFIF marker handler)
Overrides table+72 with AdobePSDHeaderParser (Adobe APP14 marker handler)
Returns the result of StateReset invoked on the receiver; the function is itself called from sub_50F632

unresolved: The receiver object owning this+0x190 is not named in the packet; the allocator vfunc contract (arguments 0, 92) is only inferred from this call site
table+0 is written with StateReset but has no dedicated packet field evidence ref, so the first slot is grounded on source and the global only
Slot semantics (which APP markers route to which handler) are implied by the handler names but not proven here
